aliases: 5MP Fixed-focal Wi-Fi Outdoor Pan & Tilt Network Camera
features: Active Defense small PT camera: motorized pan & tilt (Pan 0-345, Tilt 0-90) for 360 view
smart dual light: 30 m IR + 30 m warm light color night vision
sound and light alarm active deterrence
AI human and vehicle detection, abnormal sound alarm
Wi-Fi 6 (IEEE 802.11b/g/n/ax 2.4 GHz) + RJ-45 ethernet + Bluetooth pairing
two-way talk, microSD up to 256 GB, DMSS app
release_notes: The Dahua Picoo P5AS is a 5MP outdoor mains-powered Wi-Fi 6 pan & tilt camera in the Active Defense line, with auto tracking, smart dual-light color night vision, AI human/vehicle detection and sound-and-light active deterrence. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Consumer Wi-Fi pan-tilt camera managed via the DMSS app; ONVIF/RTSP is not stated on the datasheet. Add via the Generic Camera integration if RTSP is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Dahua' profile; RTSP is not confirmed on the datasheet.
